plot: While Grandma naps before sunset tea, Max taps her blue yarn ball and chases it all over the house; pulling it back only knots the chairs, until he stumbles backwards and finds that walking his chase route in reverse undoes the yarn, but winding the last bit shrinks Grandma's half-knitted hat, which becomes Mouse's tiny winter hat when Max tells the truth.

script.title: Roll It Back Before Grandma Wakes

beats.say: Oh no, oh no! The blue yarn is all over the house!
Under the sofa! Round the chair! Round the lamp! Everywhere!

beats.text: ROLL IT BACK BEFORE SHE WAKES!

beats.say: One hour earlier. Grandma sits in her chair by the window.
Look, Max. My new winter hat. Soft and blue.
The hat is only half done. Two blue needles stick out.
And a fat blue yarn ball sits in her basket.
Careful, dear. The yarn is still joined to my hat.
I'm just looking, Grandma. Only looking. With my eyes.
Max only looking at a ball? That never happens!
The sun is warm. The chair is soft. Grandma yawns.
I'll just rest my eyes. Wake me up for tea at sunset.
And Grandma falls fast asleep. Shhh.
Max looks at the yarn ball. It's round. It's fluffy.
Just one tiny tap. Nobody will ever know.
Tap! The ball rolls off the basket and across the rug.
Come back, little ball! I'm a tiger! Rrrr!
The ball bumps the sofa and bounces away. Boing!
Max chases it under the sofa. Round the big chair.
Round the lamp, under the table, and down the hall.
Max! What are you doing? You're making a spider web!
Max stops. He looks back. Blue yarn is everywhere.
Oh. Oh no. Did I do all that? In one minute?
Back to now. The sun is sinking. Tea time is close.
When the sun goes down, Grandma wakes up for tea.
If she sees this, her new hat is ruined!
Then roll it up! Quick! Pull the ball back!
Max finds the ball by the front door. He pulls. Hard.
The yarn goes tight. Tighter. TWANG!
The chairs slide together. The lamp wobbles. Wobble, wobble.
Stop! Stop pulling! It's making a knot!
A big knot. Round the chair legs. Three times!
Pulling makes it worse. And Grandma might wake up!
Grandma snuffles in her sleep. Max and Bird freeze. Shhh.
Phew. Still asleep. But hurry, the sky is turning pink!
Max steps back. Then he trips on the yarn... backwards.
He stumbles back around the chair. The way he came.
And the yarn loop slides right off the chair leg. Loose!
Wait! Going backwards undoes it! The way I came!
I'll go the same way I ran. But all backwards!
Backwards round the chair. Then the lamp. Then the table!
Max walks backwards round the lamp. Wind, wind, wind.
Bird carries the yarn over the top of the bookshelf.
I'll do under the sofa! I'm the only one small enough!
Mouse crawls under the sofa and pushes the yarn out.
There's a lost sock under here too! And a dusty cookie!
The ball gets bigger. And the house gets tidier.
The table is free! The rug is free! You're doing it, Max!
But the sun is low. Grandma moves in her chair. Mmm.
She's waking up! Only the last bit is left. Hurry!
Max winds faster. The yarn leads all the way to Grandma's lap.
Wind, wind, wind. Max doesn't stop.
And in Grandma's lap, the blue hat starts to get smaller.
Max! Stop winding! You're undoing Grandma's hat!
The yarn is joined to her hat! She told me!
Max stops. But the hat is now tiny. Teeny tiny.
It's so small. It would only fit... me.
Then Grandma opens her eyes. She sees the giant yarn ball.
And she sees the teeny tiny hat.
Grandma, I'm sorry. I tapped the ball. Then I chased it.
I rolled it all back up. But your hat got small.
Oh, Max. Thank you for telling me the truth.
Grandma picks up the tiny hat. She smiles. Then she laughs.
Well! This is the perfect size for somebody.
She puts the tiny blue hat right on Mouse's head.
A winter hat! For me! I'm the warmest mouse in town!
Everybody laughs. Even Max. Even Grandma, until she snorts.
Mouse has a hat, and Max has the biggest yarn ball ever!
Now you can hold the yarn while I knit my hat again.
I'll hold it very still. No tapping. Promise.
When you make a mess, say sorry, then help fix it.
Grandma? Tomorrow, can I learn to knit too? With my paws?
With your paws? Oh, this I have to see!

long.title: Roll It Back Before Grandma Wakes Up! 🧶
long.description:
"It was only one tiny tap. Now the yarn is everywhere!" 🐱
Grandma naps before tea, and Max chases her blue yarn ball all over the house. Can he roll it all back before the sun goes down and she wakes up? Max the Curious Cat, Ep 44.
